content.description:
Adoodles is a community-driven collectibles NFT project. Adoodle NFTs are made up of over a hundred exciting traits of faces, hair, hats, body, and backgrounds. Each Adoodle is a unique, non-fungible token (NFT) on the Cardano blockchain.

Holding a Adoodle allows you to participate in coordinating the Adoodles Community Treasury. This Treasury will be seeded with 420 000 ADA after the public sale ends! Holders can vote for experiences, activations, and campaigns that benefit the Adoodles.

The road map for Adoodles is collaborative and will be decided by Adoodle holders. With imaginative ideas, adequate resources, and coordination, we believe we can bring Adoodles to every vertical of popular culture! Join the Adoodles community on Twitter, Discord, and Telegram!
